PM Modi Proposes Civil Defence Volunteer Force

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has proposed the establishment of a Civil Defence volunteer force. The initiative aims to modernize the existing Civil Defence structure. The capital city is reportedly short of 55,000 volunteers needed for such a force. The proposal seeks to create a new volunteer cadre to enhance civil defence capabilities.
